pulso.name: Pulso
pulso.desc: Offline-first personal finance PWA with sync and demo mode.
pulso.problem: Track personal finances without constant connectivity, with data that survives offline and syncs later.
pulso.whatIDid: Designed and built an offline-first PWA (frontend + API) with reliable sync, in-browser statement imports, and en/es i18n.
decisions: Outbox pattern for offline → online sync without dropping operations.
Dexie on the client for local storage; NestJS + Prisma + Postgres on the server.
CSV/Excel/PDF import entirely in the browser, plus a demo mode with temporary accounts.

reapersquad-accounts.name: Accounts panel
reapersquad-accounts.desc: Accounts panel for ReaperSquad: auth and user management. Deployed on Coolify with Docker.
reapersquad-accounts.problem: Manage ReaperSquad accounts and user access with a clear, deployable admin panel.
reapersquad-accounts.whatIDid: Built the auth and user-management panel in Next.js, with Zustand state and Docker/Coolify deploy.
decisions: Next.js + React for a fast-to-iterate admin UI.
Zustand for session state and account flows.
Docker + Coolify for a reproducible deploy.

dashboard-landing.desc: Interactive order dashboard demo. Deployed on Vercel.
dashboard-landing.problem: Show a modern order dashboard demo with motion and shared UI state — no real backend required.
dashboard-landing.whatIDid: Built an interactive dashboard landing in Next.js with HeroUI components, Framer Motion, and Zustand, deployed on Vercel.
decisions: HeroUI + Tailwind for a consistent, fast-to-compose component system.
Framer Motion for panel micro-interactions without overloading the demo.
Zustand for lightweight demo/UI state; Vercel deploy to iterate in public.
